name: Lugwere
region: Eastern Uganda (Bugwere): Pallisa, Budaka, Kibuku and the Bugwere lowlands between Busoga and Bugisu
translator_note: Pallisa-town Lugwere in the register a young trader would use, written with the Lugwere Bible orthography: single consonants (emotoka, esimu, sente, ebeeyi), z where Lusoga writes dh and Luganda jj (kiiza, eizula, zona), ny rather than nh, ti- negatives (tiwali, tikyetaagisa), -ire perfectives and okugya for go. Verbs: Linnya, Gabana, Pangisa, Tuma; Kwata ku UG for Book, Kuba esimu for Call ahead, Kulikayo for the welcome. Lugwere sits between Lusoga and Luganda and shares most of this vocabulary with them, so where Bugwere speech has its own word that differs from both (the first-person pronoun, the words for now, say, and put, the perfective passives) the wording may be leaning on the Lusoga form; those keys and all app-only terms (plug-in, endpoint, API key, sandbox, concierge) are listed under uncertain.

strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Buli kibuga ku maapu kubo okuva e Kampala era siteegi ku bwakyo. Awali app ey'ekitundu emaze okukola, UG ekwasa yo ekitundu ekisembayo mu kifo ky'okwefuula eti eriyo.
strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Maapu okuva ku Felt. Enkola z'embeera y'obwire okuva ku Infrared City. Eby'okwesanyusaamu okuva ku Tazama. Okufuga awatali kukozesa ngalo okuva ku Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Buli kiyungibwaku kya kuyunga ekirina endagiriro yaakyo n'ekisumuluzo kyakyo, ebibiikibwa ku kyuma kino okutuusa lw'oyingira. Yunga kimu, peesa ezikwatagana zaaka mu Gabana, Kyalira ne Hustle Mode. Tiwali kiva mu UG awatali kiyungibwaku ky'okoleezezza.
strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: Abavuganya batekebwa ku lukalala mu bugenderevu. Omusaabaze eyeesiga okugeraageranya airayo okugabana n'okupangisa.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG katale okusooka. App z'okuyeta emotoka zifuna ebikwatibwa ebimaze okwizuzibwa nga tizisaswire kufuna bakasitoma. Abapangisa emotoka bafuna abapangisa ba wiikendi abakeberebwa. Lodge zifuna ebibiina ebituuka ku lunaku olumanyibwa. Badereeva bafuna oluguudo olwizwire nga tibanasimbula.
strings.ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates: Badereeva ne namba z'emotoka ezikakasibwa, SOS mu lugendo egabana w'oli mu kaseera ako n'omuntu gw'olonda, enkuufiira ku buli boda egabanibwa, ne lisiiti ku buli siringi.
strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Ikumi ku buli kikumi ku kugabana, sente entongole ez'okutekawo emotoka ku kupangisa, okusasulwa buli wiiki ku MoMo okuyita mu Flutterwave, ne bakasitoma b'otalina kwerangira.
strings.ops.p.deep_links_that_open: Emikutu egyigulawo app yo nga w'okimibwa ne w'oleekebwa bimaze okwizuzibwa. Titulaga beeyi gye tutabalirira mu lwatu, era enkola efulumizibwa.
